title: Hospital Ship
medium: Metal bicycle frame, stainless steel wire, metal and miniatures

said.q: it was the activity of the viewer that I considered art…to see sculpture you have to move around it, and I was trying to boil it down to the core. I thought, ‘If the core is forcing people to move, then maybe that is where the art is.’
said.in: quoted in interview with Jarrett Earnest, “Applying Pressure”, November 5th, 2013, online

said.q: if most postmodern works are scaled to the size of familiar art objects, precisely in order to pass more easily, Burden’s projects are outsized; they are too big or too small, and they are always difficult.
said.in: Chris Burden: A Twenty-Year Survey, exh. cat., Orange County Museum of Art, Newport Beach, 1988, p. 25
